title: Kenworth T909 FUPS Custom Road Train Bullbar #14
description: Kenworth T909 high tensile fully polished aluminium FUPS Bullbar 381 style channel. 100 mm diameter 6mm wall hi-tensile pipe for maximum protection. Optional 76mm or 88mm pipe can be ordered. Flat bar mounts for driving lights to customer requirements. 100mm box uprights shown with outer uprights set flush with main channel. Cow catcher and four small uprights. Reversible aluminium road train signs. Indicator repeater lights mounted inside outer uprights. Provision for front mudflaps. Bull bar can be custom built to your requirements.
